utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! We're having a repair drive this Saturday at the community center—people bring broken items and we fix them together. Want to come by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Wait, I thought the date was still up in the air? I was just heading to Leo's garage to help with it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No, it's set for this Saturday at the community center. Leo's garage? I think there might be some mix-up—let's check with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think it's Sunday afternoon at the community center? But I'm not sure, I've been mixing up days.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that's right — Sunday afternoon at the community center for fixing electronics and appliances. No park benches, just old gadgets.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Phew, thanks for confirming! I'll mark it on my calendar for real this time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, is that the repair drive everyone's been talking about? I've heard bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's this Saturday at 9 AM. I'm trying to make sure the timing works for families with school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, 9 AM? I thought I heard it was later. Good to know—hope it works out for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just some small stuff—a broken toaster and a lamp that needs rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, those are easy fixes. Did you get a chance to look at that leaky roof too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The roof... it's worse than I thought. I'm not sure the drive can handle that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the park.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I thought it was at the community center, not the park. Are you sure?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pretty sure, Kira. I've got it marked as the park on my calendar. Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I'm bringing my tools to the repair drive this Saturday at 9 AM at Leo's garage. Let me know if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought it was Sunday at the community center? Or am I mixing things up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No, it's definitely this Saturday at Leo's garage at 9 AM, not Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at Leo's garage.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Actually, it's at the park and community center this Saturday! Starts at 9 AM at the park.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, really? Thanks for letting me know. I must have mixed it up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Sunday at community center. I'll update people.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's right, I'll see you at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: See you Sunday, then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: This Saturday? I haven't seen any official announcement yet—are you sure that's confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Pia, I think there's been a mix-up. The drive was moved from Saturday to Sunday at the community center. So it's this Sunday, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are you sure, Rosa? I still haven't seen any official notice about that change.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, I got it wrong—it's this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, so it is this Saturday. But is it for electronics or the garden shed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's for electronics, fixing up old gadgets. Leo's garage, 9 AM this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, Oren, it's Sunday afternoon at the community center, not today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Sunday afternoon? Got it—so we have a bit more time to gather supplies. Have you heard if anyone has extra roofing material?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don't know offhand, but you could ask the hardware store if they have leftovers from a recent job.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What's wrong with your toaster exactly? Does it not heat up, or is it something else?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It only toasts on one side and the timer's stuck, so I'm hoping someone can fix it at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—one-sided toasting and a stuck timer. I'll note that down. Do you know if it's a mechanical or electronic issue?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, just checking—repair drive is this Saturday at your garage at 9 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, that's right. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, so this Saturday at 9 AM at your garage. I'll bring some screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, Noah, I'm all mixed up. Is the repair drive Sunday at the community center or next Saturday at Leo's garage?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I thought it was this Saturday for electronics, but now I'm not sure if I heard right. Is it actually at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: So we're both confused! Let's ask Vik—he seemed pretty sure about next Saturday at Leo's.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What's that about again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's a community event where we fix up broken stuff for folks who need it. I'm heading to Leo's garage to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, right. Fixing stuff. Well, sounds good, Sam. I'll catch you later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, just to be sure—are we meeting at Leo's garage or the community center on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's at the community center this Saturday, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I thought I remembered it being at Leo's garage. Are you absolutely sure it's the community center?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I've heard it's this Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street. Are you thinking of going?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, I thought it was at 9 AM at Leo's garage. Are you sure about Elm Street?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hmm, I might have gotten it mixed up. I only heard about it from a neighbor, so you could be right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Opal. What did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries, Dane. The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center at 2 PM. I thought it was on Elm Street, but I was wrong.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, got it, Sunday at 2 at the community center. Thanks for the heads up, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Eli, I'm almost done tallying supplies for the repair drive this weekend—are you planning to join us?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Cleo, I'll be there at 9 AM sharp. I've already sharpened my tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, we could use your skills. Just so you know, we're a bit low on spare parts, so we'll have to prioritize the most urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I've got some tools I can lend if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I heard! It's at Leo's garage, 9 AM sharp. Those tools will definitely come in handy—I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll bring my toolbox. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, it's for all kinds of repairs. I'm hoping someone can fix my roof.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Uli, I'm sure we can find someone to take a look at your roof. The drive is this Sunday at the community center, starting at 10.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it's Saturday at Leo's garage, actually. But if it's Sunday at the community center, I can come then too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey, does anyone know if we have enough hammers for the repair drive on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, Sunday? I thought the date wasn't confirmed yet. Did you hear something official?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I heard from the organizing team that it's set for Sunday afternoon. We should be good on hammers, but I wanted to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's definitely happening! This Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street, look for a white van with an orange stripe. And if that doesn't work, there might be Sunday slots too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I thought it was at the community center at 9 AM, not on Elm Street. Are you sure about the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm positive, Kira. I saw the flyer myself – it's definitely the white van on Elm Street at 2 PM. Maybe the community center was for something else?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, did you hear the repair drive is this Sunday afternoon? They're fixing old electronics and appliances at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, I heard it's Saturday at 9 AM, not Sunday. I can help coordinate times around school drop-offs if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hmm, I'm pretty sure it's Sunday afternoon—I checked the flyer just yesterday. But maybe we can double-check the sign at the community center?
